items.title: Pay chimney renovation invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Invoice (document) date is 19.11.2026. This is a private-law payment term ('binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum'), counted under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the event (19.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026. 14 days later lands on 03.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). 03.12.2026 is a Thursday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final due date: 03.12.2026. (Allow about one business day earlier, i.e. send by 02.12.2026, for a bank transfer to arrive per § 675s BGB.)

warnings: The invoice names a German Musterbank AG IBAN that checks out structurally (valid German IBAN, correct checksum and bank code), but a valid IBAN only shows the format is correct, not who actually owns the account — compare it with any earlier invoices or the company's known bank details before paying, and since 9 October 2025 your bank will check the payee name against the account (Empfängerüberprüfung); do not pay if that check reports no match.
